dataset_scope: Exact deterministic bytes and sentinel, configured nonce bound and deterministic write-key membership; no exact issued nonce ledger or complete linearizability history.
endpoint_semantics: Endpoint files are bound, not semantically accepted here. Independent endpoint-stage reader validates populations and overlapping intervals separately.
input_inventory_format: Original absolute path -> {bytes, sha256}, including matrix.json, native endpoint files and every original input read by the unchanged audit; no detached endpoint hash list.
input_layout_changes_from_predecessor: Only owned root/preparation paths and CRC control and owned-buffer candidate role pins; runtime/audit schemas and semantic predicates unchanged.
measurement_scope: Both repeats; per-workload/concurrency/role and per-operation plus merged raw histograms; retain all outcomes/attempts. Pooled QPS=sum calls/sum elapsed; pooled mean=sum latency/count; pooled quantiles from merged counts, never averaged.
